lines.en: Would you like to learn about eastern box turtles?
What would you like to say?
: Hi, Kaori. Please teach me about whatever that thing is.
: this is the eastern box turtle its scientific name is terrapene carolina and it is a reptile
: the eastern box turtle is one of the most common turtles human beings encounter in the wild and they normally grow to around six inches
: there are many different types of box turtles and they all come in different colors what is your favorite color friend i bet it is blue
: i knew it anyway you can find the eastern box turtle near ponds and rivers and they normally like warm weather but not too hot because then they will get hot
: eastern box turtles are omnivores like human beings and eat all sorts of things like human beings but not human beings because they are too large
: like many other hard circle lizards the eastern box turtle will retract its limbs into its shell in order to protect itself kind of like a horse if horses could do that
: did you know that after breeding the female terrapene carolina can lay eggs for up to four years afterward thats crazy what if humans could egg
: they can also live up to one hundred years old on many occassions and like land more than pretty much any other turtle are you learning friend are you having fun
: Yes, Kaori. I am having a blast.
: hooray for learning and hooray for fun we should adopt an eastern box turtle and name him franklin like the popular tv show franklin about a turtle named franklin do you remember that show
: I can not say I do.
: anyway i hope you enjoyed the turtle lesson and that you will consider obtaining one as a human pet in the future because they are very friendly and cuddly but not so cuddly because shell
: remember to always get a captive bred pet if it is an option because we do not want to disturb the ecosystem anyway burger time goodbye friend i love you but i mean friend love hello
